verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly has a dedicated first-party docs page, "Scheduled flag changes" under its releases section, which maps directly to scheduling flag changes for a future time. Its progressive rollouts docs add time-based automated release progression, but the pack shows only these page titles, not their contents. Missing for 10: detail on scheduling granularity and supported change types (targeting, rollouts, on/off), evidence that scheduling works via API/CLI as well as the UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
